A docker_host_integration node rejects non-allowlisted destination paths with 'path is outside host allowlist' (default allowlist /etc,/opt,/usr/local/bin,/var/lib). Expected safety behaviour; recorded so future transfer fixtures target an allowlisted path or a native node.
